title: Pin opum-lore and opum-quest at v0.11.0
description: Orchestrator dispatch (OPAG-465 AC4): the lore-cli/quest-cli 0.11.0 pair is released and qualified. Bump both federated pins in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json from v0.9.3 (lore) and v0.10.0 (quest) to v0.11.0 in one change, and re-resolve+record the skills/ subtree baseline for each in scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json, per this file's own re-verify-in-the-same-change rule (OMARK-52/OMARK-43).

acceptanceCriteria.text: marketplace.json pins opum-lore (lore-cli) and opum-quest (quest-cli) at ref v0.11.0
scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json records the independently re-resolved skills/ subtree SHA for both entries at v0.11.0, with a note describing the verification chain
lore check and the federated-pin/content checker scripts pass locally against the new pins
change lands on dev via PR and is promoted to main; both pins confirmed by reading origin/main directly

plan: 1. Independently re-resolve lore-cli v0.11.0 and quest-cli v0.11.0 tag chains and skills/ subtree SHAs (done)
3. Update marketplace.json pins and scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json in one commit
4. Run lore check and the federated-pin/content checker scripts locally
5. Push, open PR, wait for required checks green, squash merge to dev
6. Promote dev to main, verify pins at origin/main, close task in this PR
implementationNotes: AC1-3 verified: marketplace.json + .agents/plugins/marketplace.json (Codex mirror) both pin v0.11.0 for opum-lore/opum-quest; scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json records independently re-resolved skills/ subtree SHAs with full verification-chain notes; lore check (0 errors), lore agents --check, quest agents --check, check-federated-pins.mjs, and check-federated-content.mjs all pass locally. PR opum-ai/opum-marketplace#166, required checks (check · manifests, lore check, Tracker integrity) green on head 0d9e51f after a follow-up commit regenerated the stale Codex manifest mirror. AC4 pending merge+promotion.
finalSummary: Bumped the federated opum-lore/opum-quest pins from lore-cli v0.9.3 / quest-cli v0.10.0 to the released, qualified v0.11.0 pair (Opum constitution Article 3; opum-cli-e2e pass-2 receipt origin/main 40cb46edacaa2e0befc86c93151519d26ce33df0, receipts/pair/0.11.0.json, QUALIFIED, 483 pass/0 fail/1 routine-blocked). Both tag chains (lore: 1734cc96->bb225f1c, quest: 84cc917d->eb1d9f46) were re-resolved independently via local git fetch + git ls-remote --tags, cross-corroborated by lore-cli's LCLI-469 handshake and the e2e receipt, before recording the skills/ subtree baselines in scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json: lore's skills/ is byte-identical to v0.9.3 (ce580cd1...); quest's changed one benign file, skills/quest/SKILL.md (subtree now e007a327...). Bumping the pin surfaced real drift the checks were meant to catch: lore check failed under 0.11.0 with schema-drift plus two new upstream types (Constitution, Constants) needing lore schema export, and check · manifests failed CI on the first push because .agents/plugins/marketplace.json (the Codex mirror) was stale -- both fixed in the same PR via node scripts/generate-codex-marketplace.mjs. Delivered via PR opum-ai/opum-marketplace#166 (squash-merged to dev at a0d1d58840bcd48ac1f6e4b7aaee3291628334ab, required checks check · manifests/lore check/Tracker integrity green on the exact merged SHA) and promoted to main via PR #167 + git push origin origin/dev:main (fast-forward, no merge commit; the 'promotion guards' job's failure on #167 is its documented, non-required anti-merge-button trip wire, not a defect). Both pins reconfirmed directly from origin/main after promotion: opum-lore v0.11.0, opum-quest v0.11.0, in both .claude-plugin/marketplace.json and its Codex mirror.
